description: Validation rules specific to NIH Chest X-ray dataset (DICOM/PNG images)
note: NIH imaging data excluded from current pipeline due to missing state-level geography

rules.name: image_file_readable
rules.description: Image file must be readable as valid DICOM or PNG
rules.condition: File cannot be opened by imaging library (pydicom, PIL)
rules.rationale: Cannot process corrupted or non-image files

rules.name: dicom_metadata_present
rules.description: DICOM file must have metadata header
rules.rationale: Metadata needed for patient ID, study date, modality

rules.name: patient_id_anonymized
rules.description: Patient ID must be anonymized (no real PHI)
rules.condition: Patient ID matches pattern suggesting real SSN or MRN

rules.name: pathology_labels_present
rules.description: Image must have associated pathology labels CSV
rules.condition: Image filename not found in pathology labels CSV
rules.rationale: Labels needed for clinical context, but not for pipeline metrics

rules.name: nln_derived_labels_tolerance
rules.description: NLP-derived labels may have 10-15% error rate
rules.rationale: Labels extracted via NLP from radiology reports (weak supervision)

rules.name: image_dimensions_valid
rules.description: Image must have non-zero width and height

rules.name: geographic_metadata_missing
rules.condition: No state field in DICOM metadata or labels CSV
rules.rationale: Cannot join to Virginia cohort without state information
rules.action_on_failure: Set nih_geo_limited=1; exclude from VA joins
rules.workaround: Use for image processing pipelines only, not geographic stratification

rules.name: study_date_derivable
rules.description: Image must have study date for temporal analysis
rules.condition: DICOM StudyDate tag missing or invalid
rules.rationale: Temporal context needed for time-series analysis
rules.action_on_failure: Set low_precision_time=1; use file metadata date

rules.name: image_view_position_labeled
rules.description: Image should have view position (PA, AP, lateral)

rules.name: multi_label_classification_tolerance
rules.description: Images may have multiple pathology labels
rules.rationale: Real-world chest X-rays often show multiple findings

nih_geo_limited.description: NIH imaging data lacks state-level geography
nih_geo_limited.impact: Excluded from Virginia cohort joins; available for image processing only

low_precision_time.description: Study date missing; using file metadata date
low_precision_time.impact: Reduced temporal precision for time-series analysis

low_confidence_label.impact: May be excluded from clinical accuracy analyses

nih_specific_assumptions.label_derivation: NLP from radiology reports (ChestX-ray14 paper, Wang et al., 2017)

current_implementation_status.reason: Missing state-level geography prevents Virginia cohort join
current_implementation_status.future_work: Could be used for image processing pipeline benchmarks (latency for DICOM parsing, PNG compression)

validation_pass_criteria.v1_strict: All metadata present; labels validated; geographic data required
validation_pass_criteria.v2_relaxed: Image readable + patient ID anonymized + nih_geo_limited=1 flag accepted

cross_references.original_paper: Wang et al. (2017). ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database
